issues: The dedicated types file is named `award-types.ts`, but the spec's structure rule requires `<feature>-types.ts`; since the feature directory is `awards`, the file should be `awards-types.ts` to match the naming convention exactly.
result.reason: The awards feature set conforms to the Feature Module Conventions: a single entry point (index.ts) re-exports the full public API (run as pickWinners, PickWinnersInput, Award); logic lives in a verb-first kebab-case file (pick-winners.ts) with one exported `run`, Result-based error handling, and consumer-grade error messages; all files are reachable from index.ts (no orphans); the files serve one capability (yearly awards); and the feature name describes the capability rather than its implementation.

The awards feature module satisfies all specification criteria: it has exactly one entry point (index.ts) that re-exports the public API, types are in a dedicated award-types.ts file, logic files follow verb-first kebab-case naming and service conventions, all files are reachable from the entry point, the feature has a single cohesive capability (award selection), and the feature name describes the capability rather than implementation.
